dct_description_sm:
Polygon boundaries indicating the collection areas of the City of Waterloo's leaf collection program. The City of Waterloo’s loose leaf collection program begins in late October and runs for about four weeks. Residents are asked to rake leaves to the curb as close as possible to their collection date. Please be aware that this program is weather dependent, and may be delayed or cancelled based on conditions.

For more information, please visit http://www.waterloo.ca/en/living/leafcollection.asp.
